newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia has invited Arab investors to contribute to two petrochemical projects worth more than $130 million.
- A new 60 million riyal packaging plant in Saudi starts production.
- Banned anti-rheumatism drug is being sold illegally in Saudi Arabia.
- Saudi Arabia to pay farmers 3.3 billion riyals next month.
- Savola Company of Saudi Arabia posts 62.7 million riyal net profit in the first six months of 1997.
- Saudi to build 86 educational projects worth 227 million riyals.
